notes: Wayshell Flight (story_flight). templates\flight_template.flp = boss_heart_v2raw with the struck Analog Harp (decay 1.46 s, sustain 0, release 0.4 s) renamed harp_struck (insert 2), Analog Lab "French Horn Solo" (a sampled Mellotron horn, velocity-responsive, no samples above F5) on brass (insert 6), Ah Voice on choir (insert 4), 12 Low Strings on brass_low (+12, insert 8) and a clone strings_hi on insert 5 (+12). v2 (review v1, 2 MAJOR): templates\flight_template2.flp; the OB-Xa B-1 French Horn read as a near-sine, so the horn is the Mellotron; A' rewritten with the horn an octave down (D4-B4, velocity 88: the Mellotron moves ~0.4 dB per step) and the strings on the written top line; harp glissandi 12 velocity steps softer. v3 (review v2 MAJOR: the Mellotron horn was too dark, 2-6 kHz -50 dB): templates\flight_template3.flp adds a clone of the brass channel named trumpet (Analog Lab Trumpfal, same insert 6) at VOL -20 dB, so the trumpet's bright attack sits under the Mellotron's sustain (horn stem 2-6 kHz -24.6 dB). Build with --audition "strings_high=strings_hi;harp=harp_struck;choir_ah=choir;horns_french=brass,trumpet;bass_arco=brass_low" --transpose maps/story_flight_transpose.json --fix maps/story_flight_fix.json on the template with channels renamed (iid 1 harp_struck, 11 bell_marrow_sub, 13 strings_hi, 15 trumpet). Gains horns 10.5, Pro-L trim +1.2 (projects\story_flight_v3c.flp). v4 (review v3 MAJOR: Trumpfal dies ~0.6-1.0 s into a note, so held notes went dark again): templates\flight_template4.flp swaps the clone's preset for Analog Lab Orchestral Brass 'Dirty Bronze' (sustains bright: h2 -2, h3 -12 dB on held notes, in tune; picked in a split audition, templates\horn_audition2.flp, against Prophet '43 Horn' (dark) and 'Cresc. Horns 1' (swells, +19 c)). Clone renamed 'bronze' (iid 15), VOL -24 dB (-14 took over: horn +4.7 dB, 2-6 kHz -11); --audition '...;horns_french=brass,bronze;...'; horns gain 9.8. v5 (review v4 MINOR: A' darker than A): the A' horn is its own part horns_a2, and templates\flight_template5.flp adds a second Dirty Bronze clone 'bronze_hot' (iid 16, insert 6) at VOL -21 dB; --audition '...;horns_french=brass,bronze;horns_a2=brass,bronze_hot;...' --fix maps/story_flight_v5_fix.json, renames as v4 plus 16 bronze_hot; same gains and trim 1.2 (projects\story_flight_v5.flp). A' horn 2-6 kHz -13.4 (A -13.3; v4 A' -15.2). v6 (review v5 MINOR 3: the louder bronze raised its sub-octave series; bar 22's D#5 sat +3 dB over the mix at 622 Hz): templates\flight_template6.flp routes bronze and bronze_hot to insert 7 (the unused timpani insert, which has Pro-Q 4), part 'bronze_layer' here: 300 Hz 24 dB/oct lowcut, -8 dB bell at 622 Hz Q 4. The cut took 0.9 dB off the whole horn, so horns_french and bronze_layer gains are 10.7 (projects\story_flight_v6c.flp, same build command as v5 on flight_template6). v7: bronze_layer insert keeps 1.5-6 kHz only (the sub-octave series is gone). v8: +3 dB bell at 1.1 kHz Q1 on the Mellotron insert 6; the A' horn (horns_a2) on its own Mellotron clone brass_a2 (maps/story_flight_v8_fix.json).
